opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a way to earn Ethereum, not merely as a lesson on withdrawing cryptocurrency: it calls Forsage “the platform where people are making money through Ethereum” and addresses viewers who want “to earn etherium.” It further frames participation as producing withdrawable earnings by explaining “whatever you earn in Forsage” and how to take that Ethereum into a bank account through Trust Wallet. The description reinforces that solicitation with the claim, “HOW I MADE 7 ETHEREUM ($1600) ON THIS PLATFORM FOR FREE! WITH PROOF!” Alongside the Forsage-branded interface’s repeated sections and selectable levels, these features indicate a recruitment-oriented earning structure, with WhatsApp offered for further information, rather than a standalone withdrawal tutorial.
